title: Person assembling a wheeled device
visual_facts: A person uses a blue-handled screwdriver on a small wheeled device on a table.
The device has a teal frame, two black wheels visible at the front, exposed wiring, and yellow components inside.
A silver rectangular panel is held open at the side of the device.
A roll of black tape sits in the foreground, and a laptop is partly visible at the right edge.
spatial_relations: The person leans over the device, with the screwdriver at its upper edge.
The tape roll is in front of the device, near the table's front edge.
uncertainties: The device's function and identity are not established.
The lettering on the tape roll is only partly legible.
